description_short: Build and operate elaborate museums, send experts on expeditions, collect exhibits, manage guests and staff, and customize every hall in a humorous management simulation.
description_ar: لعبة إدارة وبناء متاحف من Two Point Studios. أرسل الخبراء في بعثات، اجمع المعروضات، صمم القاعات والجولات، وأدر الموظفين واحتياجات الزوار مع عدد كبير جدًا من المعروضات والديكورات.
nintendoPlayModes: TV Mode, Tabletop Mode, Handheld Mode
fitFor: Players who enjoy optimization and humor

gameplayPillars.title: Museum Design
gameplayPillars.description: Build halls, themed areas, facilities, decorations and guest routes.

gameplayPillars.title: Expeditions
gameplayPillars.description: Send Experts across expedition maps to recover rare exhibits and complete the sticker book.

gameplayPillars.title: Guest Experience
gameplayPillars.description: Balance education, entertainment, cleanliness, security, tours, facilities and donations.

gameplayPillars.title: Exhibit Management
gameplayPillars.description: Maintain artifacts, habitats and interactive displays while protecting them from damage and thieves.

gameplayPillars.title: Sandbox Creativity
gameplayPillars.description: Use the sandbox to build large custom museums beyond the campaign structure.

storyChapters.title: Fledgling Curator
storyChapters.body: Begin managing museums across Two Point County.

storyChapters.title: Expanding Collections
storyChapters.body: Unlock new museum themes and expedition regions as your experts discover increasingly unusual exhibits.

storyChapters.title: Mega Museums
storyChapters.body: Progress toward highly customized, large-scale museums with specialized staff and guest systems.

faq.q: How large is Two Point Museum?
faq.a: Nintendo/Deku listings place the Switch 2 download at roughly 4.6 GB before additional DLC.
Crowdsourced data lists about 47 hours for the main story and around 96 hours for completionist play.
No. It is a single-player management simulation.
Explorer content, Fantasy Finds, Zooseum and Arty-Facts are among the major Switch 2 DLC releases.

faq.q: How does it run on Switch 2?
faq.a: Two Point Studios lists a 1920x1080 target at 30 FPS.

verdictSummary: A large, charming management sandbox with excellent content density, broad customization and strong long-term expansion support.
verdictCons: Dense management can become complex in large museums

reviews.quote: Strong reviews for the depth, humor and expansion of the Two Point management formula.
Critics widely praised its management depth, charm and long-term creativity.
Player aggregate data lists an 8.0 user score.

timeline.body: The Switch 2 version and Explorer content became available.

patchNotes.body: Native Switch 2 release with the complete base museum-management campaign and sandbox.
Added a wildlife museum, Wildlife Experts, Farflung Isles, 40+ wildlife exhibits and a new campaign.
Added Undee Docks, Art Experts, an art expedition map, 27+ art exhibits and an Art Studio room.

studioAbout: Two Point Studios specializes in humorous management simulations. Two Point Museum expands the Two Point formula into museum curation, expeditions, exhibits, guest behavior, themed construction and long-form sandbox management.
setupNeeds: Nintendo Switch 2 system required for the Nintendo Switch 2 version.
Internet connection is required for digital download, updates and online/service features where applicable.
Nintendo Account required for Nintendo eShop purchase/download.
Sufficient internal storage or compatible microSD Express storage required.
Nintendo Switch Online membership is required only for game-specific online multiplayer/features that explicitly use it.
